title: Clocked
description:
The adventure takes place in a steampunk universe, within a Great Clock, an unpretentious building where scientific activity takes place, as part of research into new energy sources... or so the story goes. 

You take on the role of an automaton, limited to moving, running and interacting, accompanied by a calculator-being that will stick with you until the end of the adventure.

The building is labyrinthine, forcing you to make numerous trips back and forth in order to progress through the story, a classic piece of architecture.

The puzzles are simple, all you have to do is find notes containing activation codes for generators.

The adventure is meant to be short, but it will take longer to uncover all that Clocked hides.

The game is simple on the surface, but will be more difficult in this other dimension.

You'll have to use your dexterity to avoid the symbiotic clusters that will surprise you during your health walk.

This is an important dimension, as it will give you access to areas that are normally inaccessible...think about it!

You'll be juggling between the "default" world and this one to navigate the Great Clock.

A classic adventure, but a story full of mystery, unclear on the surface.

There's a lot to discover in Clocked, and the adventure revolves more around exploration than escape from the Great Clock.

There are several endings, each offering a unique experience, packed with information about the history surrounding the Great Clock.

Don't forget to chat with your calculator friend, he's very chatty.

EXTENSION 1 : The White Veil be extends toward the symbiote origin.

• A new level to find, larger than the CLOCKED's main level.

• A hidden level full of challenge behind one of the CLOCKED's ends.

• New story, new revelation.

• 3 alternative endings, one of which requires you to finish the game at 100%.

• 15 new achievements.

• A new game mechanic and a new danger.

• A new NPC to keep you company.

• Lots of secrets to discover.

EXTENSION 2 : New investigation about a mysterious prophete.

• 6 hidden levels in the Great Clock.

• 2 news plots on a cult and a conspiracy.

• 2 news game mecanics.

• A new puzzle type.

• 12 skins to unlocks.

• 15 news achievements.

• 3 intenses challenges.

• Only 1 ending.
description_short: Two worlds coexist, but one of them didn't exist yesterday. That's why you, an automaton, and your calculator sidekick, are looking for a way out of the Great Clock, searching for answers, but above all to find a way out of this place that's gathering dust.
